description: This file implements an audit logging module for tracking API actions, storing audit events in a MongoDB collection. It provides initialization and logging functions, defines data structures for audit context, and sets up database indices.

classes.name: AuditContext
classes.description: Holds the initialized audit collection reference for logging.

methods.name: None init_audit(collection: Collection)
methods.description: Initializes the audit system with a MongoDB collection and creates necessary indices.

methods.name: None log_audit(action: str, device_name: Optional[str], status: str, details: Optional[Dict[str, Any]] = None, ip: Optional[str] = None)
methods.description: Logs an audit event into MongoDB with details such as action, device name, status, IP, and additional info.

ctags.name: log_audit
ctags.pattern: /^def log_audit(action: str, device_name: Optional[str], status: str, details: Optional[Dict[str, /
ctags.signature: (action: str, device_name: Optional[str], status: str, details: Optional[Dict[str, Any]] = None, ip: Optional[str] = None)
